svg.text: Genmitsu 3018-PROVer V2 retrofit · selected source-bound wiring

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#D0D2CD; stroke-width:0.1500; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

svg.title: J2 — USB_A (illustrated: usb_port_a)
USB Type-A host receptacle
svg.desc: USB Type-A (USB-A) through-hole host receptacle on the left edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime, above the USB-B device port, silkscreened "USB MASTER - USB-A connector (currently not functional in firmware)". Flat top-down illustration: the stamped steel shell, its darker front face, the wide USB-A mating aperture with the folded shield-finger contacts visible inside, and the four gold-plated through-hole shield-mounting legs.

svg.title: J4 — RJ45_Hanrun_HR911105A (illustrated: ethernet_rj45)
Ethernet RJ45 jack - HanRun HR911105A (flat top-down style)
svg.desc: Shielded RJ45 10/100 magjack (J4) on the left edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime, drawn flat from directly above with no perspective. The jack mouth faces left, out of the board edge; the green and yellow link/activity LEDs are moulded into that front bezel.

svg.title: J1 — USB_B (illustrated: usb_port)
USB Type-B receptacle
svg.desc: USB Type-B (USB-B) through-hole receptacle on the left edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime, silkscreened "USB DEVICE - USB-B connector providing serial and mass storage connectivity to a pc". Flat top-down illustration: the stamped steel shell with its rolled seam, stamped detent dimples and two board-lock tabs, and the characteristic USB-B aperture - a square opening with two chamfered corners - in the mating face at the left, pointing off the board edge.

svg.title: J5 — Screw_Terminal_01x04 (illustrated: motor_connector)
Motor connector (4-position 3.5 mm screw terminal)
svg.desc: Four-position 3.50 mm pitch screw terminal block for one bipolar stepper motor, drawn flat from directly above: green moulded body with four slotted clamp screws on its top face and four wire-entry openings along the board-edge side. Component-only crop: the unpopulated alternate 2.54 mm pin-header footprint option and its silkscreen outline boxes have been removed.

svg.title: J6 — Screw_Terminal_01x04 (illustrated: motor_connector)
Motor connector (4-position 3.5 mm screw terminal)
svg.desc: Four-position 3.50 mm pitch screw terminal block for one bipolar stepper motor, drawn flat from directly above: green moulded body with four slotted clamp screws on its top face and four wire-entry openings along the board-edge side. Component-only crop: the unpopulated alternate 2.54 mm pin-header footprint option and its silkscreen outline boxes have been removed.

svg.title: J7 — Screw_Terminal_01x04 (illustrated: motor_connector)
Motor connector (4-position 3.5 mm screw terminal)
svg.desc: Four-position 3.50 mm pitch screw terminal block for one bipolar stepper motor, drawn flat from directly above: green moulded body with four slotted clamp screws on its top face and four wire-entry openings along the board-edge side. Component-only crop: the unpopulated alternate 2.54 mm pin-header footprint option and its silkscreen outline boxes have been removed.

svg.title: J8 — Screw_Terminal_01x04 (illustrated: motor_connector)
Motor connector (4-position 3.5 mm screw terminal)
svg.desc: Four-position 3.50 mm pitch screw terminal block for one bipolar stepper motor, drawn flat from directly above: green moulded body with four slotted clamp screws on its top face and four wire-entry openings along the board-edge side. Component-only crop: the unpopulated alternate 2.54 mm pin-header footprint option and its silkscreen outline boxes have been removed.

svg.title: J12 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: power_screw_terminal_round)
XT30 power connector (2-pole)
svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.title: J13 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: ssr_header)
SSR output header (2-pin, J44 / J45)
svg.desc: Two gold pins of a bare 1x02 2.54 mm pin header, flat top-down style. Component-only crop: the oversized dark plastic base rectangle and its white silkscreen corner tabs have been removed.

svg.title: J14 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: power_screw_terminal_round)
XT30 power connector (2-pole)
svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.title: J9 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: vmot_terminal)
VMOT power in (XT30 connector)
svg.desc: Amass XT30 male power connector mounted vertically on the board, drawn flat from directly above: yellow nylon shroud with two chamfered polarising corners on its lower short end, a darker rectangular mating recess, and two gold bullet contacts 5 mm apart inside it, VMOT at the top and GND at the bottom.

svg.title: J10 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: ssr_header)

svg.title: J16 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: power_screw_terminal_round)
XT30 power connector (2-pole)
svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.text: GUESS is dotted and unverified. SOURCE is solid and reported, not hardware-tested. OPEN shows a visible gap; do not connect.
A wire crossing is not a junction unless a dark dot marks the same authored graph net.
Source drawing gives contact location, not fitted cable, rating, firmware or safe-machine qualification.
Keep each named supply and return domain separate until its source contract proves a join.
Prime pad chips identify exact contacts; solid grey connector-bank locators are annotations, not conductors.

text.tspan: Wire colour describes electrical function; line pattern shows evidence state.
SOURCE is reported, not hardware-tested. GUESS is proposed and unverified. OPEN
is disconnected. Crossings are not junctions unless a named shared-net junction
